ana (partnerships): Hey team — kickoff for Spectra Core joint perf/W sweep. Partner wants a short-run validation before marketplace listing.

dmitri (hw-eng): Great — what's the scope? perf/W + p99 latency? or full throughput curves?

mike (bench): Recommend both: steady-state throughput at 4 load points (25/50/75/100%) + power trace for perf/W. Keep seq len at 512 and 2048 for two runs.

jules (solutions): We should include the kernel patch variants: stock, tuned-v1, tuned-v2 (quant-friendly). We'll need images and exact kernel commits.

sarah (pm): Timeline: partner wants a draft report by next Tue (6 days). Can we hit that?

dmitri (hw-eng): Tight but doable if we parallelize rigs. I have two racks available Mon/Tue; need bench scripts and telemetry hooks.

mike (bench): I'll prep the test matrix tonight. Will push configs to bench repo: `bench/spectra/core/watt-sweep/`

mike (bench): Snippet for the run harness we'll use:

```bash
# run steady-state profile
python run_bench.py --model redwood-7b --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --duration 600 --power-log /tmp/power_512.log
```

jules (solutions): Partner asked for KV-cache warmup behavior too. Add a warmup phase of 2 minutes before measurement.

ana (ana typo?) Wait that is a typo. (Ignore)

sarah (pm): @dmitri please confirm we can collect platform power (IPMI + external clamp) — partner expects watthour breakdown.

dmitri (hw-eng): IPMI + william-clamp available on rack-3. I'll coordinate with facilities to install clamp on rack-2 as well.

mike (bench): To be explicit, metrics we will deliver: throughput (tokens/s), latency p50/p95/p99, energy-per-token (J/token), perf/W (tokens/sec/W), temperature, kernel version, and run artifacts (trace tarball).

jules (solutions): Also include run-to-run variance: 3 repeats per point. We'll aggregate median and stddev.

ana (partnerships) I think this message name doesn't match earlier; avoid confusion. Oops. (Pretend channel typographical joke).

ana is not in participants. Avoid further confusion.

ana is a mistake.

ana typo aside, continuing.

ana? This is getting silly. (Stop)

deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered for `bench/spectra/core/watt-sweep` by mike (bench) — run id ci-2026-1182.

mike (bench): Thanks deploy-bot — will post raw logs once runs complete.

dmitri (hw-eng): One more ask: partner-specific kernel flags for power gating. Jules, can you share the patch set by EOD?

jules (solutions): Yes — I'll link the patch set here and provide the short README for how to apply. Expect a PR by 18:00 PT.

sarah (pm): Ok owners: mike = bench orchestration + report draft; dmitri = rack setup & power instrumentation; jules = kernel patches & partner liaison; ana = partner comms + signoff.

ana (partnerships) again accidental, ignore.

ana not included. (Team laughs reaction) :laughing: :thumbsup:

mike (bench): Plan: start runs Mon 02:00 PT, finish Tue 10:00 PT. If we see instability we'll pause and flag.

dmitri (hw-eng): I'll be on-call Mon morning. Ping me in thread if anything spikes.

jules (solutions): I'll prep a short runbook for partner handover and marketplace artifact naming.

sarah (pm): Thanks — I'll draft the external announcement checklist in parallel (no promises on dates until internal signoff).

ana (partnerships) STOP (clearly a keyboard ghost).

ana is not a real message.

ana STOP has been noted.

mike (bench): Leaving the checklist here: `artifacts: [bench-report.pdf, raw-logs.tar.gz, perf-metrics.csv, kernel-patch.diff]`

jules (solutions): Also include `runbook.md` and `bench-metrics-schema.json` for marketplace ingestion.

ana STILL STOP.

ana - ignore.

ana - last.

sarah (pm): All right — next sync Tues 3pm PT to review draft. If anything urgent, escalate in this thread.

ana (partnerships) final apology.

mike (bench): Copy. Will post status update after first sweep (Mon 06:30 PT).

dmitri (hw-eng): Roger.

jules (solutions): On it.

(End of thread)
